    What the evidence supports

    Originals and reconstructions stay separate

    Original owner issues retain their actual fit and issue clocks. The qualified early snapshots have timestamps but lack proven durable original delivery. Historical reconstruction rows were fitted after the games and cannot be counted as original forecasts.

    No combined season score is calculated from these mixed policies, and no metric is recomputed from rounded display values. Current-season outcomes did not select the displayed historical champions.

    Availability is part of the result

    A missing historical leader is shown as unavailable even when an operational fallback has an original forecast. A TBD kickoff is displayed without the provider’s placeholder time.

    DraftKings, Kalshi and Polymarket quote values are absent from this selected-output export. Each remains a separate source gap here; saved market comparisons and exact coverage receipts are documented in the project evidence. A conditional threshold contract is never presented as an expected margin.

    Display qualifications and source freshness

      This file is a saved snapshot. Opening it does not acquire a score, refresh an injury, infer a forecast, change a model, or create a wager. The latest source-observation clock for every game remains visible.
